Note: this is only useful for servos.

parameters.name: FW_AT_APPLY
parameters.shortDesc: Controls when to apply the new gains
parameters.longDesc:
After the auto-tuning sequence is completed,
a new set of gains is available and can be applied
immediately or after landing.

values.description: Do not apply the new gains (logging only)
Apply the new gains after disarm
Apply the new gains in air

parameters.name: FW_AT_AXES
parameters.longDesc:
Defines which axes will be tuned during the auto-tuning sequence

Set bits in the following positions to enable:
0 : Roll
1 : Pitch
2 : Yaw

parameters.name: FW_AT_MAN_AUX
parameters.shortDesc: Enable/disable auto tuning using a manual control AUX input
parameters.longDesc: Defines which RC_MAP_AUXn parameter maps the manual control channel used to enable/disable auto tuning.

parameters.name: FW_AT_SYSID_F0
parameters.shortDesc: Start frequency of the injected signal
parameters.longDesc: Can be set lower or higher than the end frequency

parameters.name: FW_AT_SYSID_F1
parameters.shortDesc: End frequency of the injected signal
parameters.longDesc: Can be set lower or higher than the start frequency

parameters.name: FW_AT_SYSID_TIME
parameters.longDesc: Duration of the input signal sent on each axis during system identification

parameters.name: FW_AT_SYSID_TYPE
parameters.longDesc: Type of signal used during system identification to excite the system.

parameters.name: CBRK_BUZZER
parameters.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 782097 will disable the buzzer audio notification.

Setting this parameter to 782090 will disable the startup tune, while keeping
all others enabled.

parameters.name: CBRK_FLIGHTTERM
parameters.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 121212 will disable the flight termination action if triggered
by the FailureDetector logic or if FMU is lost.
This circuit breaker does not affect the RC loss, data link loss, geofence,
and takeoff failure detection safety logic.

parameters.name: CBRK_IO_SAFETY
parameters.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 22027 will disable IO safety.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

parameters.name: CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK
parameters.shortDesc: Circuit breaker for power supply check
parameters.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 894281 will disable the power valid
checks in the commander.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

parameters.name: CBRK_USB_CHK
parameters.shortDesc: Circuit breaker for USB link check
parameters.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 197848 will disable the USB connected
checks in the commander, setting it to 0 keeps them enabled (recommended).

We are generally recommending to not fly with the USB link
connected and production vehicles should set this parameter to
zero to prevent users from flying USB powered. However, for R&D purposes
it has proven over the years to work just fine.

parameters.name: CBRK_VTOLARMING
parameters.shortDesc: Circuit breaker for arming in fixed-wing mode check
parameters.longDesc:
Setting this parameter to 159753 will enable arming in fixed-wing
mode for VTOLs.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

parameters.name: COM_ACT_FAIL_ACT
parameters.shortDesc: Set the actuator failure failsafe mode
parameters.longDesc:
Note: actuator failure needs to be enabled and configured via FD_ACT_*
parameters.

parameters.name: COM_ARMABLE
parameters.longDesc: Set 0 to prevent accidental use of the vehicle e.g. for safety or maintenance reasons.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_AUTH_ID
parameters.longDesc: Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_AUTH_MET
parameters.longDesc:
Methods:
- one arm: request authorization and arm when authorization is received
- two step arm: 1st arm command request an authorization and
2nd arm command arm the drone if authorized

Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ
parameters.longDesc: By default off. The default allows to arm the vehicle without a arm authorization.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_AUTH_TO
parameters.longDesc:
Timeout for authorizer answer.
Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_BAT_MIN
parameters.longDesc:
Threshold for battery percentage below arming is prohibited.

A negative value means BAT_CRIT_THR is the threshold.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_CHK_ESCS
parameters.shortDesc: Enable checks on ESCs that report telemetry
parameters.longDesc:
If this parameter is set, the system will check ESC's online status and failures.
This param is specific for ESCs reporting status. It shall be used only if ESCs support telemetry.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_HFLT_CHK
parameters.shortDesc: Enable FMU SD card hardfault / watchdog detection check
parameters.longDesc:
This check detects if there are hardfault / watchdog files present on the
SD card. If so, and the parameter is enabled, arming is prevented.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_IMU_ACC
parameters.longDesc: Maximum accelerometer inconsistency between IMU units that will allow arming

parameters.name: COM_ARM_IMU_GYR
parameters.shortDesc: Max rate gyro inconsistency for arming
parameters.longDesc: Maximum rate gyro inconsistency between IMU units that will allow arming

parameters.name: COM_ARM_MAG_ANG
parameters.shortDesc: Max magnetic field inconsistency for arming
parameters.longDesc:
Maximum magnetic field inconsistency between units that will allow arming

Set -1 to disable the check.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_MAG_STR
parameters.longDesc:
Check if the estimator detects a strong magnetic
disturbance (check enabled by EKF2_MAG_CHECK)

parameters.name: COM_ARM_MIS_REQ
parameters.longDesc: The default allows to arm the vehicle without a valid mission.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_ODID
parameters.shortDesc: Open Drone ID system check and in-flight failsafe
parameters.longDesc: Actions other than warning also prevent arming.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_ON_BOOT
parameters.longDesc:
When enabled, the vehicle arms automatically once all preflight checks pass after boot.
The vehicle will not re-arm after a manual disarm.
Has no effect if COM_ARMABLE is 0.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_SWISBTN
parameters.shortDesc: Arm switch is a momentary button
parameters.longDesc:
0: Arming/disarming triggers on switch transition.
1: Arming/disarming triggers when holding the momentary button down like the stick gesture.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_TRAFF
parameters.shortDesc: Enable Traffic Avoidance system detection check
parameters.longDesc:
This check detects if a traffic avoidance system (ADSB/FLARM transponder)
is missing. Depending on the value of the parameter, the check can be
disabled, warn only, or deny arming.

parameters.name: COM_ARM_WO_GPS
parameters.longDesc:
Configures whether arming is allowed without GNSS, for modes that require a global position
(specifically, in those modes when a check defined by EKF2_GPS_CHECK fails).
The settings deny arming and warn, allow arming and warn, or silently allow arming.

parameters.name: COM_CC_TEMP_WARN
parameters.longDesc:
Arming is not prevented as the temperature typically drops in flight.

Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: COM_CPU_MAX
parameters.shortDesc: Maximum allowed CPU load to still arm
parameters.longDesc:
The check fails if the CPU load is above this threshold for 2s.

A negative value disables the check.

parameters.name: COM_DISARM_LAND
parameters.shortDesc: Time-out for auto disarm after landing
parameters.longDesc:
A non-zero, positive value specifies the time-out period in seconds after which the vehicle will be
automatically disarmed in case a landing situation has been detected during this period.

A zero or negative value means that automatic disarming triggered by landing detection is disabled.

parameters.name: COM_DISARM_PRFLT
parameters.shortDesc: Time-out for auto disarm if not taking off
parameters.longDesc:
A non-zero, positive value specifies the time in seconds, within which the
vehicle is expected to take off after arming. In case the vehicle didn't takeoff
within the timeout it disarms again.

A negative value disables autmoatic disarming triggered by a pre-takeoff timeout.

parameters.name: COM_DLL_EXCEPT
parameters.longDesc:
Specify modes in which ground control station connection loss is ignored and no failsafe action is triggered.
See also COM_RCL_EXCEPT.

parameters.name: COM_DL_LOSS_T
parameters.longDesc: After this amount of seconds without datalink, the GCS connection lost mode triggers

parameters.name: COM_FAIL_ACT_T
parameters.shortDesc: Delay between failsafe condition triggered and failsafe reaction
parameters.longDesc:
Before entering failsafe (RTL, Land, Hold), wait COM_FAIL_ACT_T seconds in Hold mode
for the user to realize.
During that time the user can switch modes, but cannot take over control via the manual control override feature (see MAN_OVERRIDE_SPD).
Afterwards the configured failsafe action is triggered and the user may use manual control override.

A zero value disables the delay.

parameters.name: COM_FLIGHT_UUID
parameters.longDesc:
This number is incremented automatically after every flight on
disarming in order to remember the next flight UUID.
The first flight is 0.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE1
parameters.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE2
parameters.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE3
parameters.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE4
parameters.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE5
parameters.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE6
parameters.longDesc:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

parameters.name: COM_FLTMODE_BOOT
parameters.longDesc:
Flight mode set on boot and after a power cycle, before any RC input or
mode command is received.

parameters.name: COM_FLTT_LOW_ACT
parameters.longDesc:
Action the system takes when the remaining flight time is below
the estimated time it takes to reach the RTL destination.

parameters.name: COM_FLT_TIME_MAX
parameters.longDesc:
The vehicle aborts the current operation and returns to launch when
the time since takeoff is above this value. It is not possible to resume the
mission or switch to any auto mode other than RTL or Land. Taking over in any manual
mode is still possible.

Starting from 90% of the maximum flight time, a warning message will be sent
every 1 minute with the remaining time until automatic RTL.

Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: COM_FORCE_SAFETY
parameters.longDesc: Force safety when the vehicle disarms

parameters.name: COM_GNSSLOSS_ACT
parameters.longDesc:
Action the system takes when a GNSS failure is detected during flight.
Triggers when the active GNSS count drops below SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS (disabled
when SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS=0), or when two receivers report positions inconsistent
with their reported accuracy and SYS_HAS_NUM_GNSS=2 (otherwise warning only).
Any value above Warning also blocks arming.

parameters.name: COM_HLDL_LOSS_T
parameters.shortDesc: High Latency Datalink loss time threshold
parameters.longDesc: After this amount of seconds without datalink the data link lost mode triggers

parameters.name: COM_HOME_EN
parameters.longDesc:
Set home position automatically if possible.

During missions, the latitude/longitude of the home position is locked and will not reset during intermediate landings.
It will only update once the mission is complete or landed outside of a mission.
However, the altitude is still being adjusted to correct for GNSS vertical drift in the first 2 minutes after takeoff.

parameters.name: COM_HOME_IN_AIR
parameters.shortDesc: Allows setting the home position after takeoff
parameters.longDesc:
If set to true, the autopilot is allowed to set its home position after takeoff
The true home position is back-computed if a local position is estimate if available.
If no local position is available, home is set to the current position.

parameters.name: COM_LOW_BAT_ACT
parameters.longDesc:
Action the system takes at critical battery. See also BAT_CRIT_THR and BAT_EMERGEN_THR
for definition of battery states.

values.description: Return at critical level, land at emergency level

parameters.name: COM_MODE0_HASH
parameters.longDesc:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

parameters.longDesc:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes

which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

parameters.name: COM_MODE_ARM_CHK
parameters.shortDesc: Allow external mode registration while armed
parameters.longDesc: By default disabled for safety reasons

parameters.name: COM_OBL_RC_ACT
parameters.longDesc:
The offboard loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_OF_LOSS_T in seconds.

parameters.name: COM_OF_LOSS_T
parameters.longDesc:
Time-out to wait when offboard connection is lost before triggering offboard lost action

See COM_OBL_RC_ACT to configure action.

parameters.name: COM_PARACHUTE
parameters.longDesc:
Require a MAVLink parachute system for arming and the failsafe action when missing or unhealthy.

Warning only warns without preventing arming. Actions other than Warning also prevent arming.

parameters.name: COM_POS_FS_EPH
parameters.shortDesc: Horizontal position error threshold for hovering systems
parameters.longDesc:
This is the horizontal position error (EPH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe.
If the previous position error was below this threshold, there is an additional
factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation).
Only used for multicopters and VTOLs in hover mode.
Independent from estimator positioning data timeout threshold (see EKF2_NOAID_TOUT).

Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: COM_POS_LOW_ACT
parameters.longDesc:
Action the system takes when the estimated position has an accuracy below the specified threshold.
See COM_POS_LOW_EPH to set the failsafe threshold.
The failsafe action is only executed if the vehicle is in auto mission or auto loiter mode,
otherwise it is only a warning.

parameters.name: COM_POS_LOW_EPH
parameters.longDesc:
This triggers the action specified in COM_POS_LOW_ACT if the estimated position accuracy is below this threshold.
Local position has to be still declared valid, which requires some kind of velocity aiding or large dead-reckoning time (EKF2_NOAID_TOUT),
and a high failsafe threshold (COM_POS_FS_EPH).

Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: COM_POWER_COUNT
parameters.shortDesc: Required number of redundant power modules
parameters.longDesc:
This configures a check to verify the expected number of 5V rail power supplies are present. By default only one is expected.
Note: CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK disables all power checks including this one.

parameters.name: COM_PREARM_MODE
parameters.longDesc:
Condition to enter the prearmed state, an intermediate state between disarmed and armed
in which non-throttling actuators are active.

parameters.name: COM_RAM_MAX
parameters.shortDesc: Maximum allowed RAM usage to pass checks
parameters.longDesc:
The check fails if the RAM usage is above this threshold.

A negative value disables the check.

parameters.name: COM_RCL_EXCEPT
parameters.longDesc:
Specify modes in which stick input is ignored and no failsafe action is triggered.
External modes requiring stick input will still failsafe.
Auto modes are: Hold, Takeoff, Land, RTL, Descend, Follow Target, Precland, Orbit.

parameters.name: COM_RC_IN_MODE
parameters.longDesc:
Selects stick input selection behavior:
either a traditional remote control receiver (RC) or a MAVLink joystick (MANUAL_CONTROL message)

Priority sources are immediately switched to whenever they get valid.

0 RC only. Requires valid RC calibration.
1 MAVLink only. RC and related checks are disabled.
2 Switches only if current source becomes invalid.
3 Locks to the first valid source until reboot.
4 Ignores all sources.
5 RC priority, then MAVLink (lower instance before higher)
6 MAVLink priority (lower instance before higher), then RC
7 RC priority, then MAVLink (higher instance before lower)
8 MAVLink priority (higher instance before lower), then RC

parameters.name: COM_RC_LOSS_T
parameters.longDesc:
The time in seconds without a new setpoint from RC or Joystick, after which the connection is considered lost.
This must be kept short as the vehicle will use the last supplied setpoint until the timeout triggers.
Ensure the value is not set lower than the update interval of the RC or Joystick.

parameters.name: COM_SPOOLUP_TIME
parameters.shortDesc: Enforced delay between arming and further navigation
parameters.longDesc:
The minimal time from arming the motors until moving the vehicle is possible is COM_SPOOLUP_TIME seconds.
Goal:
- Motors and propellers spool up to idle speed before getting commanded to spin faster
- Timeout for ESCs and smart batteries to successfulyy do failure checks
e.g. for stuck rotors before the vehicle is off the ground

parameters.name: COM_THROW_EN
parameters.longDesc: Allows to start the vehicle by throwing it into the air.

parameters.name: COM_THROW_SPEED
parameters.shortDesc: Minimum speed for the throw start
parameters.longDesc:
When the throw launch is enabled, the drone will only allow motors to spin after this speed
is exceeded before detecting the freefall. This is a safety feature to ensure the drone does
not turn on after accidental drop or a rapid movement before the throw.

Set to 0 to disable.

parameters.name: COM_VEL_FS_EVH
parameters.longDesc:
This is the horizontal velocity error (EVH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe.
The default is appropriate for a multicopter. Can be increased for a fixed-wing.
If the previous velocity error was below this threshold, there is an additional
factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation).

parameters.name: COM_WIND_MAX
parameters.longDesc:
Wind speed threshold above which an automatic failsafe action is triggered.
Failsafe action can be specified with COM_WIND_MAX_ACT.

parameters.name: COM_WIND_MAX_ACT
parameters.longDesc:
Action the system takes when a wind speed above the specified threshold is detected.
See COM_WIND_MAX to set the failsafe threshold.
If enabled, it is not possible to resume the mission or switch to any auto mode other than
RTL or Land if this threshold is exceeded. Taking over in any manual
mode is still possible.

parameters.name: COM_WIND_WARN
parameters.longDesc:
A warning is triggered if the currently estimated wind speed is above this value.
Warning is sent periodically (every 1 minute).

Set to -1 to disable.

parameters.name: NAV_DLL_ACT
parameters.shortDesc: Set GCS connection loss failsafe mode
parameters.longDesc:
The GCS connection loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_DL_LOSS_T in seconds. Once the timeout occurs the selected
action will be executed.

parameters.name: NAV_RCL_ACT
parameters.shortDesc: Set manual control loss failsafe mode
parameters.longDesc:
The manual control loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_RC_LOSS_T in seconds.

"Hold mode (no failsafe)" does not trigger the failsafe: instead, if manual control
is lost while actively flying a manual mode, the vehicle switches to Hold as a regular
mode change (no failsafe state, no alarming notification). If Hold cannot be entered
(e.g. without a valid position estimate), the normal failsafe takes over and escalates
from there (Return/Land/Descend/Terminate as applicable).

parameters.name: FW_MAN_P_MAX
parameters.longDesc: Applies to both directions in all manual modes with attitude stabilization but without altitude control

parameters.name: FW_MAN_R_MAX
parameters.longDesc: Applies to both directions in all manual modes with attitude stabilization

parameters.name: FW_MAN_YR_MAX
parameters.longDesc:
This is the maximally added yaw rate setpoint from the yaw stick in any attitude controlled flight mode.
It is added to the yaw rate setpoint generated by the controller for turn coordination.

parameters.name: FW_PSP_OFF
parameters.shortDesc: Pitch setpoint offset (pitch at level flight)
parameters.longDesc:
An airframe specific offset of the pitch setpoint in degrees, the value is
added to the pitch setpoint and should correspond to the pitch at
typical cruise speed of the airframe.

parameters.name: FW_P_RMAX_NEG
parameters.shortDesc: Maximum negative / down pitch rate setpoint

parameters.name: FW_P_RMAX_POS
parameters.shortDesc: Maximum positive / up pitch rate setpoint

parameters.name: FW_P_TC
parameters.longDesc:
This defines the latency between a pitch step input and the achieved setpoint
(inverse to a P gain). Smaller systems may require smaller values.

parameters.name: FW_R_TC
parameters.longDesc:
This defines the latency between a roll step input and the achieved setpoint
(inverse to a P gain). Smaller systems may require smaller values.

parameters.name: FW_WR_I
parameters.longDesc:
This gain defines how much control response will result out of a steady
state error. It trims any constant error.

parameters.name: FW_WR_P
parameters.longDesc:
This defines how much the wheel steering input will be commanded depending on the
current body angular rate error.

parameters.name: FW_W_EN
parameters.longDesc:
Only enabled during automatic runway takeoff and landing.
In all manual modes the wheel is directly controlled with yaw stick.

parameters.name: FW_W_RMAX
parameters.longDesc:
This limits the maximum wheel steering rate the controller will output (in degrees per
second).

parameters.name: FW_FLAPS_LND_SCL
parameters.longDesc:
Sets a fraction of full flaps during landing.
Also applies to flaperons if enabled in the mixer/allocation.

parameters.name: FW_LND_ABORT
parameters.shortDesc: Bit mask to set the automatic landing abort conditions
parameters.longDesc:
Terrain estimation:
bit 0: Abort if terrain is not found
bit 1: Abort if terrain times out (after a first successful measurement)

The last estimate is always used as ground, whether the last valid measurement or the land waypoint, depending on the
selected abort criteria, until an abort condition is entered. If FW_LND_USETER == 0, these bits are ignored.

TODO: Extend automatic abort conditions
e.g. glide slope tracking error (horizontal and vertical)

parameters.name: FW_LND_AIRSPD
parameters.longDesc:
The calibrated airspeed setpoint during landing.

If set <= 0, landing airspeed = FW_AIRSPD_MIN by default.

parameters.name: FW_LND_ANG
parameters.longDesc:
Typically the desired landing slope angle when landing configuration (flaps, airspeed) is enabled.
Set this value within the vehicle's performance limits.

parameters.name: FW_LND_EARLYCFG
parameters.longDesc:
Allows to deploy the landing configuration (flaps, landing airspeed, etc.) already in
the loiter-down waypoint before the final approach.
Otherwise is enabled only in the final approach.

parameters.name: FW_LND_FLALT
parameters.shortDesc: Landing flare altitude (relative to landing altitude)
parameters.longDesc: NOTE: max(FW_LND_FLALT, FW_LND_FL_TIME * |z-velocity|) is taken as the flare altitude

parameters.name: FW_LND_FL_PMAX
parameters.longDesc: Maximum pitch during landing flare.

parameters.name: FW_LND_FL_PMIN
parameters.longDesc: Minimum pitch during landing flare.

parameters.name: FW_LND_FL_SINK
parameters.longDesc: TECS will attempt to control the aircraft to this sink rate via pitch angle (throttle killed during flare)

parameters.name: FW_LND_FL_TIME
parameters.longDesc:
Multiplied by the descent rate to calculate a dynamic altitude at which
to trigger the flare.

NOTE: max(FW_LND_FLALT, FW_LND_FL_TIME * descent rate) is taken as the flare altitude

parameters.name: FW_LND_NUDGE
parameters.longDesc:
Approach angle nudging: shifts the touchdown point laterally while keeping the approach entrance point constant
Approach path nudging: shifts the touchdown point laterally along with the entire approach path

This is useful for manually adjusting the landing point in real time when map or GNSS errors cause an offset from the
desired landing vector. Nudging is done with yaw stick, constrained to FW_LND_TD_OFF (in meters) and the direction is
relative to the vehicle heading (stick deflection to the right = land point moves to the right as seen by the vehicle).

parameters.name: FW_LND_TD_OFF
parameters.shortDesc: Maximum lateral position offset for the touchdown point

parameters.name: FW_LND_TD_TIME
parameters.longDesc:
This is the time after the start of flaring that we expect the vehicle to touch the runway.
At this time, a 0.5s clamp down ramp will engage, constraining the pitch setpoint to RWTO_PSP.
If enabled, ensure that RWTO_PSP is configured appropriately for full gear contact on ground roll.

Set to -1.0 to disable touchdown clamping. E.g. it may not be desirable to clamp on belly landings.

The touchdown time will be constrained to be greater than or equal to the flare time (FW_LND_FL_TIME).

parameters.name: FW_LND_THRTC_SC
parameters.shortDesc: Altitude time constant factor for landing and low-height flight
parameters.longDesc: The TECS altitude time constant (FW_T_ALT_TC) is multiplied by this value.

parameters.name: FW_LND_USETER
parameters.longDesc:
This is critical for detecting when to flare, and should be enabled if possible.

If enabled and no measurement is found within a given timeout, the landing waypoint altitude will be used OR the landing
will be aborted, depending on the criteria set in FW_LND_ABORT.

If disabled, FW_LND_ABORT terrain based criteria are ignored.

values.description: Use the terrain estimate to trigger the flare (only)
Calculate landing glide slope relative to the terrain estimate

parameters.name: FW_FLAPS_TO_SCL
parameters.longDesc:
Sets a fraction of full flaps during take-off.
Also applies to flaperons if enabled in the mixer/allocation.

parameters.name: FW_LAUN_AC_T
parameters.longDesc: Launch is detected when the norm of body acceleration is above FW_LAUN_AC_THLD for FW_LAUN_AC_T seconds.

parameters.name: FW_LAUN_AC_THLD
parameters.longDesc: Launch is detected when the norm of body acceleration is above FW_LAUN_AC_THLD for FW_LAUN_AC_T seconds.

parameters.name: FW_LAUN_CS_LK_DY
parameters.longDesc:
Locks control surfaces during pre-launch (armed) and until this time since launch has passed.
Only affects control surfaces that have corresponding flag set, and not active for runway takeoff.
Set to 0 to disable any surface locking after arming.

parameters.name: FW_LAUN_DETCN_ON
parameters.longDesc:
Enables automatic launch detection based on measured acceleration. Use for hand- or catapult-launched vehicles.
Not compatible with runway takeoff.

parameters.name: FW_LAUN_MOT_DEL
parameters.longDesc: Start the motor(s) this amount of seconds after launch is detected.

parameters.name: FW_TKO_AIRSPD
parameters.longDesc:
The calibrated airspeed setpoint during the takeoff climbout.

If set <= 0, FW_AIRSPD_MIN will be set by default.

parameters.name: FW_GPSF_LT
parameters.longDesc:
The time the system should do open loop loiter and wait for GPS recovery
before it starts descending. Set to 0 to disable. Roll angle is set to FW_GPSF_R.
Does only apply for fixed-wing vehicles or VTOLs with NAV_FORCE_VT set to 0.

parameters.name: FW_GPSF_R
parameters.longDesc: Roll angle in GPS failure loiter mode.

parameters.name: FW_POS_STK_CONF
parameters.longDesc: Applies in manual Position and Altitude flight modes.

parameters.name: FW_P_LIM_MAX
parameters.longDesc: Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.

parameters.name: FW_P_LIM_MIN
parameters.longDesc: Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.

parameters.name: FW_R_LIM
parameters.longDesc: Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.

parameters.name: FW_THR_IDLE
parameters.longDesc: This is the minimum throttle while on the ground ("landed") in auto modes.

parameters.name: FW_THR_MAX
parameters.longDesc:
Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.
Should be set accordingly to achieve FW_T_CLMB_MAX.

parameters.name: FW_THR_MIN
parameters.longDesc:
Applies in any altitude controlled flight mode.
Usually set to 0 but can be increased to prevent the motor from stopping when
descending, which can increase achievable descent rates.

parameters.name: FW_T_CLMB_R_SP
parameters.longDesc:
In auto modes: default climb rate output by controller to achieve altitude setpoints.
In manual modes: maximum climb rate setpoint.

parameters.name: FW_T_SINK_R_SP
parameters.longDesc:
In auto modes: default sink rate output by controller to achieve altitude setpoints.
In manual modes: maximum sink rate setpoint.

parameters.name: FW_T_SPDWEIGHT
parameters.longDesc:
Adjusts the amount of weighting that the pitch control
applies to speed vs height errors.
0 -> control height only
2 -> control speed only (gliders)

parameters.name: FW_WING_HEIGHT
parameters.shortDesc: Height (AGL) of the wings when the aircraft is on the ground
parameters.longDesc:
This is used to constrain a minimum altitude below which we keep wings level to avoid wing tip strike. It's safer
to give a slight margin here (> 0m)

parameters.name: FW_WING_SPAN
parameters.shortDesc: The aircraft's wing span (length from tip to tip)
parameters.longDesc: This is used for limiting the roll setpoint near the ground. (if multiple wings, take the longest span)

parameters.name: FW_PN_R_SLEW_MAX
parameters.shortDesc: Path navigation roll slew rate limit
parameters.longDesc:
Maximum change in roll angle setpoint per second.
Applied in all Auto modes, plus manual Position & Altitude modes.

parameters.name: FW_GND_SPD_MIN
parameters.longDesc:
The controller will increase the commanded airspeed to maintain
this minimum groundspeed to the next waypoint.

parameters.name: FW_THR_SLEW_MAX
parameters.longDesc: Maximum slew rate for the commanded throttle

parameters.name: FW_T_F_ALT_ERR
parameters.longDesc:
Minimum altitude error needed to descend with max airspeed and minimal throttle.
A negative value disables fast descend.

parameters.name: FW_T_I_GAIN_PIT
parameters.longDesc:
Increase it to trim out speed and height offsets faster,
with the downside of possible overshoots and oscillations.

parameters.name: FW_T_RLL2THR
parameters.longDesc:
Is used to compensate for the additional drag created by turning.
Increase this gain if the aircraft initially loses energy in turns
and reduce if the aircraft initially gains energy in turns.

parameters.name: FW_T_SEB_R_FF
parameters.shortDesc: Specific total energy balance rate feedforward gain

parameters.name: FW_T_STE_R_TC
parameters.shortDesc: Specific total energy rate first order filter time constant
parameters.longDesc: This filter is applied to the specific total energy rate used for throttle damping.

parameters.name: FW_T_THR_DAMPING
parameters.longDesc: This is the damping gain for the throttle demand loop.

parameters.name: FW_T_THR_INTEG
parameters.longDesc:
Increase it to trim out speed and height offsets faster,
with the downside of possible overshoots and oscillations.

parameters.name: FW_T_THR_LOW_HGT
parameters.shortDesc: Low-height threshold for tighter altitude tracking
parameters.longDesc:
Height above ground threshold below which tighter altitude
tracking gets enabled (see FW_LND_THRTC_SC). Below this height, TECS smoothly
(1 sec / sec) transitions the altitude tracking time constant from FW_T_ALT_TC
to FW_LND_THRTC_SC*FW_T_ALT_TC.

-1 to disable.

parameters.name: FW_T_VERT_ACC
parameters.longDesc:
This is the maximum vertical acceleration
either up or down that the controller will use to correct speed
or height errors.

parameters.name: FW_WIND_ARSP_SC
parameters.longDesc:
Multiplying this factor with the current absolute wind estimate gives the airspeed offset
added to the minimum airspeed setpoint limit. This helps to make the
system more robust against disturbances (turbulence) in high wind.

parameters.name: FW_WP_RST_DIST
parameters.longDesc:
If a horizontal position reset larger than this occurs while flying between two
waypoints, fly directly to the current waypoint instead of rejoining the line.
-1 to disable.

parameters.name: NPFG_DAMPING
parameters.longDesc: Damping ratio of NPFG control law.

parameters.name: NPFG_LB_PERIOD
parameters.shortDesc: Enable automatic lower bound on the NPFG period
parameters.longDesc:
Avoids limit cycling from a too aggressively tuned period/damping combination.
If false, also disables upper bound NPFG_PERIOD_UB.

parameters.name: NPFG_PERIOD
parameters.longDesc: Period of NPFG control law.

parameters.name: NPFG_PERIOD_SF
parameters.longDesc:
Multiplied by period for conservative minimum period bounding (when period lower
bounding is enabled). 1.0 bounds at marginal stability.

parameters.name: NPFG_ROLL_TC
parameters.longDesc:
Time constant of roll controller command / response, modeled as first order delay.
Used to determine lower period bound. Setting zero disables automatic period bounding.

parameters.name: NPFG_SW_DST_MLT
parameters.longDesc:
Multiplied by the track error boundary to determine when the aircraft switches
to the next waypoint and/or path segment. Should be less than 1.

parameters.name: NPFG_UB_PERIOD
parameters.shortDesc: Enable automatic upper bound on the NPFG period
parameters.longDesc: Adapts period to maintain track keeping in variable winds and path curvature.

parameters.name: FW_AIRSPD_FLP_SC
parameters.longDesc: Factor applied to the minimum and stall airspeed when flaps are fully deployed.

parameters.name: FW_AIRSPD_MAX
parameters.longDesc: The maximal airspeed (calibrated airspeed) the user is able to command.

parameters.name: FW_AIRSPD_MIN
parameters.longDesc:
The minimal airspeed (calibrated airspeed) the user is able to command.
Further, if the airspeed falls below this value, the TECS controller will try to
increase airspeed more aggressively.
Has to be set according to the vehicle's stall speed (which should be set in FW_AIRSPD_STALL),
with some margin between the stall speed and minimum airspeed.
This value corresponds to the desired minimum speed with the default load factor (level flight, default weight),
and is automatically adpated to the current load factor (calculated from roll setpoint and WEIGHT_GROSS/WEIGHT_BASE).

parameters.name: FW_AIRSPD_STALL
parameters.longDesc:
The stall airspeed (calibrated airspeed) of the vehicle.
It is used for airspeed sensor failure detection and for the control
surface scaling airspeed limits.

parameters.name: FW_AIRSPD_TRIM
parameters.longDesc:
The trim CAS (calibrated airspeed) of the vehicle. If an airspeed controller is active,
this is the default airspeed setpoint that the controller will try to achieve.
This value corresponds to the trim airspeed with the default load factor (level flight, default weight).

parameters.name: FW_SERVICE_CEIL
parameters.longDesc:
Altitude in standard atmosphere at which the vehicle in normal configuration (WEIGHT_BASE) is still able to achieve a maximum climb rate of
0.5m/s at maximum throttle (FW_THR_MAX). Used to compensate for air density in FW_T_CLMB_MAX.
Set negative to disable.

parameters.name: FW_THR_ASPD_MAX
parameters.longDesc:
Required throttle (at sea level, standard atmosphere) for level flight at maximum airspeed FW_AIRSPD_MAX

Set to 0 to disable mapping of airspeed to trim throttle.

parameters.name: FW_THR_ASPD_MIN
parameters.longDesc:
Required throttle (at sea level, standard atmosphere) for level flight at minimum airspeed FW_AIRSPD_MIN

Set to 0 to disable mapping of airspeed to trim throttle below FW_AIRSPD_TRIM.

parameters.name: FW_THR_TRIM
parameters.longDesc: Required throttle (at sea level, standard atmosphere) for level flight at FW_AIRSPD_TRIM

parameters.name: FW_T_CLMB_MAX
parameters.longDesc:
This is the maximum calibrated climb rate that the aircraft can achieve with
the throttle set to FW_THR_MAX and the airspeed set to the
trim value. For electric aircraft make sure this number can be
achieved towards the end of flight when the battery voltage has reduced.

parameters.name: FW_T_SINK_MIN
parameters.longDesc:
This is the minimum calibrated sink rate of the aircraft with the throttle
set to THR_MIN and flown at the same airspeed as used
to measure FW_T_CLMB_MAX.

parameters.name: FW_ACRO_X_MAX
parameters.shortDesc: Acro body roll max rate setpoint

parameters.name: FW_ACRO_YAW_EN
parameters.shortDesc: Enable yaw rate controller in Acro
parameters.longDesc:
If this parameter is set to 1, the yaw rate controller is enabled in Fixed-wing Acro mode.
Otherwise the pilot commands directly the yaw actuator.
It is disabled by default because an active yaw rate controller will fight against the
natural turn coordination of the plane.

parameters.name: FW_ACRO_Y_MAX
parameters.shortDesc: Acro body pitch max rate setpoint

parameters.name: FW_ACRO_Z_MAX
parameters.shortDesc: Acro body yaw max rate setpoint

parameters.name: FW_ARSP_SCALE_EN
parameters.longDesc:
This enables a logic that automatically adjusts the output of the rate controller to take
into account the real torque produced by an aerodynamic control surface given
the current deviation from the trim airspeed (FW_AIRSPD_TRIM).

Enable when using aerodynamic control surfaces (e.g.: plane)
Disable when using rotor wings (e.g.: autogyro)

parameters.name: FW_BAT_SCALE_EN
parameters.shortDesc: Enable throttle scale by battery level
parameters.longDesc:
This compensates for voltage drop of the battery over time by attempting to
normalize performance across the operating range of the battery.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_P_VMAX
parameters.shortDesc: Pitch trim increment at maximum airspeed
parameters.longDesc: This increment is added to TRIM_PITCH when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MAX.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_P_VMIN
parameters.shortDesc: Pitch trim increment at minimum airspeed
parameters.longDesc: This increment is added to TRIM_PITCH when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MIN.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_R_VMAX
parameters.shortDesc: Roll trim increment at maximum airspeed
parameters.longDesc: This increment is added to TRIM_ROLL when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MAX.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_R_VMIN
parameters.shortDesc: Roll trim increment at minimum airspeed
parameters.longDesc: This increment is added to TRIM_ROLL when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MIN.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_Y_VMAX
parameters.shortDesc: Yaw trim increment at maximum airspeed
parameters.longDesc: This increment is added to TRIM_YAW when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MAX.

parameters.name: FW_DTRIM_Y_VMIN
parameters.shortDesc: Yaw trim increment at minimum airspeed
parameters.longDesc: This increment is added to TRIM_YAW when airspeed is FW_AIRSPD_MIN.

parameters.name: FW_FLAPS_MAN
parameters.longDesc: Chose source for manual setting of flaps in manual flight modes.

parameters.name: FW_GC_GAIN_MIN
parameters.longDesc: The range of the compression gain is between this parameter and 1.0

parameters.name: FW_MAN_P_SC
parameters.longDesc:
Scale factor applied to the desired pitch actuator command in full manual mode. This parameter allows
to adjust the throws of the control surfaces.

parameters.name: FW_MAN_R_SC
parameters.longDesc:
Scale factor applied to the desired roll actuator command in full manual mode. This parameter allows
to adjust the throws of the control surfaces.

parameters.name: FW_MAN_Y_SC
parameters.longDesc:
Scale factor applied to the desired yaw actuator command in full manual mode. This parameter allows
to adjust the throws of the control surfaces.

parameters.name: FW_PR_D
parameters.longDesc: Pitch rate differential gain.

parameters.name: FW_PR_FF
parameters.longDesc:
Direct feed forward from rate setpoint to torque setpoint.
Positive values compensate aerodynamic damping (scaled linearly with airspeed).
Negative values reduce setpoint tracking aggressiveness while preserving disturbance rejection (2-DOF controller, scaled quadratically with airspeed)

parameters.name: FW_RLL_TO_YAW_FF
parameters.shortDesc: Roll control to yaw control feedforward gain
parameters.longDesc:
This gain can be used to counteract the "adverse yaw" effect for fixed wings.
When the plane enters a roll it will tend to yaw the nose out of the turn.
This gain enables the use of a yaw actuator to counteract this effect.

parameters.name: FW_RR_FF
parameters.longDesc:
Direct feed forward from rate setpoint to torque setpoint.
Positive values compensate aerodynamic damping (scaled linearly with airspeed).
Negative values reduce setpoint tracking aggressiveness while preserving disturbance rejection (2-DOF controller, scaled quadratically with airspeed)

parameters.name: FW_SPOILERS_MAN
parameters.longDesc: Chose source for manual setting of spoilers in manual flight modes.

parameters.name: FW_USE_AIRSPD
parameters.longDesc:
If set to 1, the airspeed measurement data, if valid, is used in the following controllers:
- Rate controller: output scaling
- Attitude controller: coordinated turn controller
- Position controller: airspeed setpoint tracking, takeoff logic
- VTOL: transition logic

parameters.name: FW_YR_FF
parameters.longDesc:
Direct feed forward from rate setpoint to torque setpoint.
Positive values compensate aerodynamic damping (scaled linearly with airspeed).
Negative values reduce setpoint tracking aggressiveness while preserving disturbance rejection (2-DOF controller, scaled quadratically with airspeed)

parameters.name: CA_AIRFRAME
parameters.longDesc:
Defines which mixer implementation to use.
Some are generic, while others are specifically fit to a certain vehicle with a fixed set of actuators.

'Custom' should only be used if noting else can be used.

parameters.name: LNDFW_AIRSPD_MAX
parameters.longDesc: Maximum airspeed allowed in the landed state

parameters.name: LNDFW_ROT_MAX
parameters.shortDesc: Fixed-wing land detector: max rotational speed
parameters.longDesc:
Maximum allowed norm of the angular velocity in the landed state.
Only used if neither airspeed nor groundspeed can be used for landing detection.

parameters.name: LNDFW_TRIG_TIME
parameters.longDesc: Time the land conditions (speeds and acceleration) have to be satisfied to detect a landing.

parameters.name: LNDFW_VEL_XY_MAX
parameters.shortDesc: Fixed-wing land detector: Max horizontal velocity threshold
parameters.longDesc:
Maximum horizontal velocity allowed in the landed state.
A factor of 0.7 is applied in case of airspeed-less flying
(either because no sensor is present or sensor data got invalid in flight).

parameters.name: LNDFW_VEL_Z_MAX
parameters.shortDesc: Fixed-wing land detector: Max vertiacal velocity threshold
parameters.longDesc: Maximum vertical velocity allowed in the landed state.

parameters.name: LNDFW_XYACC_MAX
parameters.shortDesc: Fixed-wing land detector: Max horizontal acceleration
parameters.longDesc: Maximum horizontal (x,y body axes) acceleration allowed in the landed state

parameters.name: LNDMC_ALT_GND
parameters.longDesc:
The height above ground below which ground effect creates barometric altitude errors.
A negative value indicates no ground effect.

parameters.name: LNDMC_ROT_MAX
parameters.longDesc: Maximum allowed norm of the angular velocity (roll, pitch) in the landed state.

parameters.name: LNDMC_XY_VEL_MAX
parameters.longDesc: Maximum horizontal velocity allowed in the landed state

parameters.name: LNDMC_Z_VEL_MAX
parameters.longDesc:
Vertical velocity threshold to detect landing.
Has to be set lower than the expected minimal speed for landing,
which is either MPC_LAND_SPEED or MPC_LAND_CRWL.
This is enforced by an automatic check.

parameters.name: MIS_COMMAND_TOUT
parameters.shortDesc: Timeout to allow the payload to execute the mission command
parameters.longDesc:
Ensure:
gripper: NAV_CMD_DO_GRIPPER
has released before continuing mission.
winch: CMD_DO_WINCH
has delivered before continuing mission.
gimbal: CMD_DO_GIMBAL_MANAGER_PITCHYAW
has reached the commanded orientation before beginning to take pictures.

parameters.name: MIS_DIST_1WP
parameters.shortDesc: Maximal horizontal distance from Home to first waypoint
parameters.longDesc:
There will be a warning message if the current waypoint is more distant than MIS_DIST_1WP from Home.
Has no effect on mission validity.
Set a value of zero or less to disable.

parameters.name: MIS_LND_ABRT_ALT
parameters.longDesc:
Minimum altitude above landing point that the vehicle will climb to after an aborted landing.
Then vehicle will loiter in this altitude until further command is received.
Used as the default when the landing mission item does not specify its own abort altitude
(MAV_CMD_NAV_LAND param1).
Only applies to fixed-wing vehicles.

parameters.name: MIS_MNT_YAW_CTL
parameters.shortDesc: Enable gimbal yaw control in missions
parameters.longDesc:
Enable yaw control of the mount. (Only affects multicopters and ROI mission items)

If enabled, yaw commands will be sent to the mount and the vehicle will follow its heading towards the flight direction.
If disabled, the vehicle will yaw towards the ROI.

parameters.name: MIS_TAKEOFF_ALT
parameters.longDesc:
This is the relative altitude the system will take off to
if not otherwise specified.

parameters.name: MIS_TKO_LAND_REQ
parameters.longDesc:
Specifies if a mission has to contain a takeoff and/or mission landing.
Validity of configured takeoffs/landings is checked independently of the setting here.

values.description: Require a takeoff and a landing
Require both a takeoff and a landing, or neither
Same as previous when landed, in-air require landing only if no valid VTOL approach is present

parameters.name: MIS_YAW_ERR
parameters.shortDesc: Max yaw error in degrees needed for waypoint heading acceptance

parameters.name: MIS_YAW_TMT
parameters.longDesc:
Time in seconds we wait on reaching target heading at a waypoint if it is forced

If set > 0 it will ignore the target heading for normal waypoint acceptance. If the
waypoint forces the heading the timeout will matter. For example on VTOL forwards transition.
Mainly useful for VTOLs that have less yaw authority and might not reach target
yaw in wind. Disabled by default.

parameters.name: NAV_ACC_RAD
parameters.longDesc:
Default acceptance radius, overridden by acceptance radius of waypoint if set.
For fixed-wing and rovers, the high level controllers output their own acceptance radius. Those values are used instead only when above this parameter.

parameters.name: NAV_FORCE_VT
parameters.shortDesc: Force VTOL mode takeoff and land

parameters.name: NAV_FW_ALTL_RAD
parameters.shortDesc: FW Altitude Acceptance Radius before a landing
parameters.longDesc:
Altitude acceptance used for the last waypoint before a fixed-wing landing. This is usually smaller
than the standard vertical acceptance because close to the ground higher accuracy is required.

parameters.name: NAV_FW_ALT_RAD
parameters.longDesc: Acceptance radius for fixedwing altitude.

parameters.name: NAV_LOITER_RAD
parameters.longDesc:
Default value of loiter radius in fixed-wing mode (e.g. for Loiter mode).

The direction of the loiter can be set via the sign: A positive value for
clockwise, negative for counter-clockwise.

parameters.name: NAV_LTR_LAST_DL
parameters.shortDesc: Loiter at last GCS heartbeat position on data link loss
parameters.longDesc:
When the data link is lost and this setting is enabled,
the vehicle will loiter at the position where the last GCS
heartbeat was received rather than at its current position.
Only applies to Hold mode during failsafe actions.

parameters.name: NAV_MC_ALT_RAD
parameters.longDesc: Acceptance radius for multicopter altitude.

parameters.name: NAV_MIN_GND_DIST
parameters.shortDesc: Minimum height above ground during Mission and RTL
parameters.longDesc:
Minimum height above ground the vehicle is allowed to descend to during Mission and RTL,
excluding landing commands.
Requires a distance sensor to be set up.
Note: only prevents the vehicle from descending further, but does not force it to climb.

Set to a negative value to disable.

parameters.name: NAV_MIN_LTR_ALT
parameters.longDesc:
This is the minimum altitude above Home the system will always obey in Loiter (Hold) mode if switched into this
mode without specifying an altitude (e.g. through Loiter switch on RC).
Doesn't affect Loiters that are part of Missions or that are entered through a reposition setpoint ("Go to").
Set to a negative value to disable.

parameters.name: NAV_TRAFF_AVOID
parameters.longDesc:
Enabling this will allow the system to respond
to transponder data from e.g. ADSB transponders

parameters.name: NAV_TRAFF_A_HOR
parameters.shortDesc: Set NAV TRAFFIC AVOID horizontal distance
parameters.longDesc: Defines a crosstrack horizontal distance

parameters.name: NAV_TRAFF_A_VER
parameters.shortDesc: Set NAV TRAFFIC AVOID vertical distance

parameters.name: NAV_TRAFF_COLL_T
parameters.longDesc:
Minimum acceptable time until collsion.
Assumes constant speed over 3d distance.

parameters.name: MPC_TKO_RAMP_T
parameters.longDesc:
Increasing this value will make climb rate controlled takeoff slower.
If it's too slow the drone might scratch the ground and tip over.
A time constant of 0 disables the ramp

parameters.name: MPC_XY_CRUISE
parameters.shortDesc: Default horizontal velocity in autonomous modes
parameters.longDesc: e.g. in Missions, RTL, Goto if the waypoint does not specify differently

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_ALL
parameters.longDesc:
If set to a value greater than zero, other parameters are automatically set (such as
MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP or MPC_LAND_SPEED).
If set to a negative value, the existing individual parameters are used.

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_D_ACC
parameters.shortDesc: Differential gain for vertical velocity error
parameters.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s^2 velocity derivative

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_I_ACC
parameters.shortDesc: Integral gain for vertical velocity error
parameters.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m velocity integral

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN
parameters.longDesc:
Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes.
In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity.

For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP
parameters.longDesc:
Absolute maximum for all climb rate controlled modes.
In manually piloted modes full stick deflection commands this velocity.

For default autonomous velocity see MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP

parameters.name: MPC_Z_VEL_P_ACC
parameters.shortDesc: Proportional gain for vertical velocity error
parameters.longDesc: Defined as corrective acceleration in m/s^2 per m/s velocity error

parameters.name: MPC_Z_V_AUTO_DN
parameters.longDesc: For manual modes and offboard, see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_DN

parameters.name: MPC_Z_V_AUTO_UP
parameters.longDesc: For manually controlled modes and offboard see MPC_Z_VEL_MAX_UP

parameters.name: RTL_CONE_ANG
parameters.shortDesc: Half-angle of the return mode altitude cone
parameters.longDesc:
Defines the half-angle of a cone centered around the destination position that
affects the altitude at which the vehicle returns.

values.description: No cone, always climb to RTL_RETURN_ALT above destination.
Only climb to at least RTL_DESCEND_ALT above destination.

parameters.name: RTL_DESCEND_ALT
parameters.longDesc:
Descend to this altitude (above destination position) after return, and wait for time defined in RTL_LAND_DELAY.
Land (i.e. slowly descend) from this altitude if autolanding allowed.
VTOLs do transition to hover in this altitude above the landing point.

parameters.name: RTL_LAND_DELAY
parameters.longDesc:
Delay before landing (after initial descent) in Return mode.
If set to -1 the system will not land but loiter at RTL_DESCEND_ALT.

parameters.name: RTL_LOITER_RAD
parameters.longDesc: Set the radius for loitering to a safe altitude for VTOL transition.

parameters.name: RTL_MIN_DIST
parameters.shortDesc: Min distance for RTL cone altitude calculation
parameters.longDesc:
Horizontal radius from return point within which special rules for return mode apply

The return altitude will be calculated based on RTL_CONE_ANG parameter.
The yaw setpoint will switch to the one defined by corresponding waypoint.

parameters.name: RTL_PLD_MD
parameters.longDesc:
Use precision landing when doing an RTL landing phase.
This setting does not apply for RTL destinations planned as part of a mission.

parameters.name: RTL_RETURN_ALT
parameters.longDesc:
Default minimum altitude above destination (e.g. home, safe point, landing pattern) for return flight.
The vehicle will climb to this altitude when Return mode is engaged, unless it currently is flying higher already.
This is affected by RTL_MIN_DIST and RTL_CONE_ANG.

parameters.name: RTL_TYPE
parameters.longDesc: Return mode destination and flight path (home location, rally point, mission landing pattern, reverse mission)

values.description: Return to closest safe point (home or rally point) via direct path.

Return to closest safe point other than home (mission landing pattern or rally point), via direct path. If no mission landing or rally points are defined return home via direct path. Always choose closest safe landing point if vehicle is a VTOL in hover mode.

Return to a planned mission landing, if available, using the mission path while skipping DO_JUMP and other non-position mission items, else return to home via the reverse mission path with the same traversal rules. Do not consider rally points.
Return via direct path to closest destination: home, start of mission landing pattern or safe point. If the destination is a mission landing pattern, follow the pattern to land.

Return to the planned mission landing, or to home via the reverse mission path, whichever is estimated to be closer using mission item indices. Skip DO_JUMP and other non-position mission items while following either mission path. Do not consider rally points.
Return directly to safe landing point (do not consider mission landing and Home)

parameters.name: RTL_APPR_FORCE
parameters.longDesc:
Only consider home/rally RTL points that have a VTOL approach loiter.
A VTOL approach loiter is a MAV_CMD_NAV_LOITER_TO_ALT item with finite position and altitude.

parameters.name: RTL_TIME_FACTOR
parameters.shortDesc: RTL time estimate safety margin factor
parameters.longDesc:
Safety factor that is used to scale the actual RTL time estimate.
Time with margin = RTL_TIME_FACTOR * time + RTL_TIME_MARGIN

parameters.name: RTL_TIME_MARGIN
parameters.shortDesc: RTL time estimate safety margin offset
parameters.longDesc:
Margin that is added to the time estimate, after it has already been scaled
Time with margin = RTL_TIME_FACTOR * time + RTL_TIME_MARGIN

parameters.name: RWTO_NUDGE
parameters.shortDesc: Enable yaw stick nudging during runway ground roll
parameters.longDesc:
Enable use of yaw stick for nudging the wheel during runway ground roll

This is useful when map, GNSS, or yaw errors on ground are misaligned with what the operator intends for takeoff course.
Particularly useful for skinny runways or if the wheel servo is a bit off trim.

parameters.name: RWTO_PSP
parameters.shortDesc: Pitch setpoint during taxi / before rotation
parameters.longDesc:
Pitch setpoint during taxi / before takeoff rotation airspeed is reached

A taildragger with steerable wheel might need to pitch up
a little to keep its wheel on the ground before airspeed
to takeoff is reached.

parameters.name: RWTO_RAMP_TIME
parameters.shortDesc: Throttle ramp up time for runway takeoff

parameters.name: RWTO_ROT_AIRSPD
parameters.longDesc:
The calibrated airspeed threshold during the takeoff ground roll when the plane should start rotating (pitching up).
Must be less than the takeoff airspeed, will otherwise be capped at the takeoff airspeed (see FW_TKO_AIRSPD).

If set <= 0.0, defaults to 0.9 * takeoff airspeed (see FW_TKO_AIRSPD)

parameters.name: RWTO_ROT_TIME
parameters.longDesc: This is the time desired to linearly ramp in takeoff pitch constraints during the takeoff rotation

parameters.name: SYS_AUTOSTART
parameters.longDesc: CHANGING THIS VALUE REQUIRES A RESTART. Defines the auto-start script used to bootstrap the system.

parameters.name: VT_ARSP_BLEND
parameters.longDesc: Airspeed at which we can start blending both fw and mc controls. Set to 0 to disable.

parameters.name: VT_ARSP_TRANS
parameters.longDesc: Airspeed at which we can switch to fw mode

parameters.name: VT_BT_TILT_DUR
parameters.shortDesc: Duration motor tilt up in backtransition
parameters.longDesc: Time in seconds it takes to tilt form VT_TILT_FW to VT_TILT_MC.

parameters.name: VT_B_DEC_I
parameters.shortDesc: Backtransition deceleration setpoint to tilt I gain

parameters.name: VT_B_DEC_MSS
parameters.longDesc:
Used to calculate back transition distance in an auto mode.
For standard vtol and tiltrotors a controller is used to track this value during the transition.

parameters.name: VT_B_TRANS_DUR
parameters.shortDesc: Maximum duration of a back transition
parameters.longDesc: Transition is also declared over if the groundspeed drops below MPC_XY_CRUISE.

parameters.name: VT_B_TRANS_RAMP
parameters.shortDesc: Back transition MC motor ramp up time
parameters.longDesc: This sets the duration during which the MC motors ramp up to the commanded thrust during the back transition stage.

parameters.name: VT_ELEV_MC_LOCK
parameters.longDesc: If set to 1 the control surfaces are locked at the disarmed value in multicopter mode.

parameters.name: VT_FWD_THRUST_EN
parameters.shortDesc: Use fixed-wing actuation in hover to accelerate forward
parameters.longDesc:
Prevents downforce from pitching the body down when facing wind.
Uses puller/pusher (standard VTOL), or forward-tilt (tiltrotor VTOL) to accelerate forward instead.
Only active if demanded pitch  is below VT_PITCH_MIN.
Use VT_FWD_THRUST_SC to tune it.
Descend mode is treated as Landing too.

Only active (if enabled) in height-rate controlled modes.

parameters.name: VT_FWD_THRUST_SC
parameters.shortDesc: Fixed-wing actuation thrust scale in hover
parameters.longDesc:
Scale applied to the demanded pitch (below VT_PITCH_MIN) to get the fixed-wing forward actuation in hover mode.
Enabled via VT_FWD_THRUST_EN.

parameters.name: VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN
parameters.longDesc:
Enable differential thrust separately for roll, pitch, yaw in forward (fixed-wing) mode.
The effectiveness of differential thrust around the corresponding axis can be
tuned by setting VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R / VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P / VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y.

parameters.name: VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_P
parameters.shortDesc: Pitch differential thrust factor in forward flight
parameters.longDesc: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

parameters.name: VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_R
parameters.shortDesc: Roll differential thrust factor in forward flight
parameters.longDesc: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

parameters.name: VT_FW_DIFTHR_S_Y
parameters.shortDesc: Yaw differential thrust factor in forward flight
parameters.longDesc: Differential thrust in forward flight is enabled via VT_FW_DIFTHR_EN.

parameters.name: VT_FW_MIN_ALT
parameters.longDesc:
Minimum altitude for fixed-wing flight. When the vehicle is in fixed-wing mode
and the altitude drops below this altitude (relative altitude above local origin),
it will instantly switch back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.

parameters.name: VT_FW_QC_HMAX
parameters.longDesc:
Maximum height above the ground (if available, otherwise above
Home if available, otherwise above the local origin) where triggering a quad-chute is possible.
At high altitudes there is a big risk to deplete the battery and therefore crash if quad-chuting there.

parameters.name: VT_FW_QC_P
parameters.longDesc:
Absolute pitch threshold for quad-chute triggering in FW mode.
Above this the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.
Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

parameters.name: VT_FW_QC_R
parameters.longDesc:
Absolute roll threshold for quad-chute triggering in FW mode.
Above this the vehicle will transition back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.
Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

parameters.name: VT_F_TRANS_DUR
parameters.longDesc: Time in seconds used for a transition

parameters.name: VT_F_TRANS_THR
parameters.shortDesc: Target throttle value for the transition to fixed-wing flight

parameters.name: VT_F_TR_OL_TM
parameters.longDesc:
The duration of the front transition when there is no airspeed feedback available.
When airspeed is used, transition timeout is declared if airspeed does not
reach VT_ARSP_BLEND after this time.

parameters.name: VT_LND_PITCH_MIN
parameters.shortDesc: Minimum pitch angle during hover landing
parameters.longDesc:
Overrides VT_PITCH_MIN when the vehicle is in LAND mode (hovering).
During landing it can be beneficial to reduce the pitch angle to reduce the generated lift in head wind.

parameters.name: VT_PITCH_MIN
parameters.longDesc:
Any pitch setpoint below this value is translated to a forward force by the fixed-wing forward actuation if
VT_FWD_TRHUST_EN is set.

parameters.name: VT_PSHER_SLEW
parameters.shortDesc: Pusher throttle ramp up slew rate
parameters.longDesc:
Defines the slew rate of the puller/pusher throttle during transitions.
Zero will deactivate the slew rate limiting and thus produce an instant throttle
rise to the transition throttle VT_F_TRANS_THR.

parameters.name: VT_QC_ALT_LOSS
parameters.longDesc:
Altitude error threshold for quad-chute triggering during fixed-wing flight.
The check is only active if altitude is controlled and the vehicle is below the current altitude reference.
The altitude error is relative to the highest altitude the vehicle has achieved since it has flown below the current
altitude reference.

Set to 0 do disable.

parameters.name: VT_QC_T_ALT_LOSS
parameters.longDesc:
Altitude loss threshold for quad-chute triggering during VTOL transition to fixed-wing flight
in altitude-controlled flight modes.
Active until 5s after completing transition to fixed-wing.
If the current altitude is more than this value below the altitude at the beginning of the
transition, it will instantly switch back to MC mode and execute behavior defined in COM_QC_ACT.

Set to 0 do disable this threshold.

parameters.name: VT_TILT_TRANS
parameters.shortDesc: Normalized tilt in transition to FW

parameters.name: VT_TRANS_MIN_TM
parameters.longDesc: Minimum time in seconds for front transition.

parameters.name: VT_TRANS_P2_DUR
parameters.longDesc: Time in seconds it takes to tilt form VT_TILT_TRANS to VT_TILT_FW.

parameters.name: VT_TRANS_TIMEOUT
parameters.longDesc: Time in seconds after which transition will be cancelled.
